All major anatomical checkpoints (body shape, coloration, tail length) are met. The perceptual auditor detected slight noise/grain, and the boundary mask showed minor fragmentation. These are subtle artifacts typical of high-quality generations that still betray their synthetic nature upon rigorous inspection. The score is penalized from 5.0 to reflect this structural uncertainty and texture noise.
